title: TK 5 Soybean: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: TK 5 Soybean: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: TK 5 soybean is a grain soybean variety. About 78 days to harvest, 1.8 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: TK 5 soybean is a grain soybean variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1972. It takes about 78 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.75 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

**Yield:** 1.75 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

TK 5 soybean takes about 78 days from sowing to harvest. That is 6.6 days faster than the average of the 19 grain soybean varieties with a day count, 84.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.75 t/ha trails the average of its group, 1.92. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant TK 5 soybean
Grain soybean goes to feed and food processors, while vegetable soybean, or edamame, is picked green. Pick a variety rated against rust, the main soybean disease here.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 78 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 1.75 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of TK 5?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
